title: Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Amendment (Executive Remuneration) Bill 2017
short_title: Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Amendment (Executive Remuneration) Bill 2017
sponsor_party: independent candidate for the federal seat of Bass, Tas

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would cap pay for senior executives in the Commonwealth public service.
It would also require annual reports on executive remuneration.
The bill would start on 1 July 2018.
changes: The bill caps senior executive pay in the Commonwealth public service.
The bill introduces annual reporting requirements for executive remuneration.
The bill sets a commencement date of 1 July 2018.
summary.affected: Senior executives in the Commonwealth public service.
